name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck orders and kitchen
promotionalText: Receive advance orders, protect your kitchen from an excess of orders and keep serving when the coverage goes. The ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team runs service with.

Customers place an advance order and choose a collection time. Your team sees all orders on a single screen, confirms what the kitchen can prepare and then marks them as ready and collected.

NEVER PROMISE A TIME YOU CAN’T MEET
State how much your kitchen can prepare at once and how long it takes. When a collection time fills up, customers can no longer choose it, so the queue goes at the kitchen’s pace.

TAKE ORDERS AT THE HATCH
Add hatch (walk-up) orders on the same screen as advance orders, so the kitchen works from a single queue.

ONE SINGLE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen shows what to prepare now, what comes next and what is ready, with an alert when an order needs starting.

PRINT ORDER TICKETS
Connect a ticket printer in the kitchen over Bluetooth or through your local network, and order tickets print automatically.

KEEP SERVING WHEN THE COVERAGE GOES
Turn on offline protection: if the connection is lost, advance orders pause so nobody places an order you won’t see. Orders you take on the device are saved and sync when you get the connection back.

DESIGNED FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during service, get an alert when an order needs confirming and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
Set up your events and locations just once and receive orders for each one.

HatchGrab is for people who run food trucks and for their team. You need a HatchGrab account to sign in.
